artifact_policy.large_artifact_justification: Six derived sorted word inventories reproduce registered WordStar inputs without full original text order. Original six external raw pins remain explicit in scientific LOCK/PUBLIC_REPLAY_PLAN; compact commands replay public wordsets/native cache, original full commands need prepared raw caches.

claim_ceiling: Conditional constant-diagonal one-source-character per native group plus canonical closed word inventory only. No actual offset/phoneme/word meaning, source-language choice, complete key or cumulative1390-prior rejection.
